column1: Text, WhatsApp and Viber messages through Infobip, one account per website. Each message asks Infobip for its delivery report. In Infobip, forward the messages to your senders (inbound, "Forward to HTTP", JSON) to the URLs shown below - they carry a token made from the webhook secret. Turn Infobip's channel failover off: a message must stay on its channel. One provider module per channel: with another one installed for the same channel, its quiet hours zones and opt-in confirmation may apply instead.

column1: A long random value of your choice; stored encrypted. Infobip doesn't sign the per-message delivery reports or Forward-to-HTTP messages we use (its webhook subscriptions can, but we don't use them), so their URLs carry a token made from it: without a secret every webhook is refused. Changing it retires the URLs in Infobip - enter the new ones.
